+---
+assignees:

+title: Ignore removed Rust parameters with a warning, and list the canonical fields when no name matches
+---
+## What
+divergence.md Q12 as changed by P4 (DECIDED), N5, and §11 "Q12 (changed by P4)". This is work on the Swift package (S/ = Sources/FoundationModelsKanban/). Code: S/GraphQL/NameMatcher.swift, S/GraphQL/NameRewrite.swift.
+
+Problem (N5): the error message for a name that does not match suggests only names with a similar spelling. It does not list the fields of the type. A removed Rust parameter gives a general validation error with no "use X" hint.
+
+Decided behavior (final):
+- A removed Rust parameter is ignored. The call runs, and the response gets a warning in `extensions.warnings` with the text "`<name>` is removed, use X". The removed parameters (P4 list) and their hints:
+  - `project` → removed; use tags.
+  - `due`, `scheduled` → removed; no replacement (write the date in the body).
+  - `exclude_done` (`excludeDone`) → removed; use the filter `!#DONE`.
+  - `page` → removed; use `first` and `after` (cursor paging).
+  - `detail` → removed; choose the fields in the selection set.
+  - `include_counts` (`includeCounts`) → removed; select `summary` (or `totalCount`).
+  - `attachments` → removed; no replacement.
+  - Note: `model` is not in this list, because the board `model` field is added back (Q19). `avatar` is not a Rust MCP parameter.
+- Accept each removed name in its case and style forms (snake_case and camelCase).
+- A name that matches nothing still fails. The error lists the canonical field names of that type (all of them), in addition to the near-spelling suggestions.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `addTask(input: {title: "x", due: "2026-01-01"})` works and the response has a warning that `due` is removed.
+- [ ] `tasks(exclude_done: true)` works and the warning says to use `!#DONE`.
+- [ ] Each removed parameter in the list gives its own warning text.
+- [ ] `addTask(input: {title: "x", zzz: 1})` fails, and the error lists all canonical fields of `AddTaskInput`.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] A test for each removed parameter (warning text and that the call works).
+- [ ] A test for the no-match error that lists the canonical fields.
+- [ ] Tests use temporary fixture folders. Never use the `.kanban/` of this repo (it is a Rust board).
+- [ ] `swift test` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file

+  text: |-
+    Research done.
+    - Plan: the rewrite walk (S/GraphQL/NameRewrite.swift) removes a removed Rust parameter at each argument, `input` field, and variable key, when no candidate has the same words. It records one warning (code REMOVED_PARAMETER) on RewrittenDocument; `API.respond` adds these warnings to the context collector before execution. When the walk removes all arguments of a field, it removes the parentheses too, because `tasks()` does not parse. The removal range is from the start of the name to the end of the value; a comma is insignificant in GraphQL.
+    - No-match list: GraphQL `suggestionList` is internal, so the walk keeps the engine validation error and records each name with no match (source offset of the node, written name, and the list of canonical names). `callerError` appends the list to an error whose mapped position is at that offset and whose message quotes the name. The variable error of the engine ("In field \"zzz\": Unknown field.") is at the variable definition, so a variable key records the definition offset.
+    - Edge found: a removed value that is a variable (`due: $d`) leaves an unused variable, and GraphQL then reports NoUnusedVariables. The walk cannot know all uses (directives are not visited). I will add a new task for this.
+    - The doc comment of AddTaskInput in TaskMutations.swift says that the validation refuses `due`/`scheduled`; it must change.
